factory-core.summary: Workflow contract, snapshot, validation, git safety, report. Always first.

delivery.summary: Generic multi-step delivery for any repository: run lead / task lead flow, agent routing and fallback, cross-model review, worktrees, QA tiers, plan/verdict/gate pipeline. No module owner; factory-core calls it.

pin-bump.summary: Move a client pin (manifest+lock, DOTS Sample) to a released sgl-v or package v* tag.

wire-contract.summary: Drive a wire/protocol/cross-language contract change: server -> Netcode -> ready to tag -> pin-bump.

measure.summary: Benchmarks, encoding sweeps, re-baselining and multi-client verification with expected value, control and run id.

server-realtime.summary: C# game server + Shared.GameLogic: ECS systems, phases, replication, knobs, metrics, golden vectors, AOT.

server-services.summary: Go gateway, Nakama RPCs, shared Redis store, persistence and migrations.

server-ops.summary: Docker, compose, k3s/k8s/Agones, monitoring, backups, CD workflows.

unity-package.summary: Development inside Netcode, UnityDots, UIToolkit up to ready-to-tag.

client-integration.summary: Unity client glue: VContainer scopes, Nakama/session, HUD/UI, DotsViews, build scripts.

dotnet-gameserver.summary: How the C# .NET 10 game server and Shared.GameLogic work: tick order, rates, ECS world and locking, zero-alloc idioms, SGL C# limits, Net layer, xUnit idioms and single-test filters, AOT.

go-backend.summary: How the Go gateway, shared and Nakama plugin modules work: module wiring without go.work, entry points, storage seams, test doubles (miniredis, httptest, Nakama mocks), single-test commands, integration-test pitfalls.

unity-client-tech.summary: How the Unity 6 client code works: Entities system install and world lifecycle, UniTask and main-thread rules, VContainer, asmdef and test-assembly rules, domain reload, WebGL limits, single-test runs through Unity MCP or batchmode.

unity-dots.summary: How Entities/Burst/Jobs code works in UnityDots and the client: ECS-vs-classic decision, group tree and bootstrap install, SystemOrderVerifier, the package ECB singleton, measured Schedule vs ScheduleParallel thresholds, archetype-stable spawn, sync points, allocators, change filters, ECS tests.

netcode-client.summary: How com.cuvara.netcode works on the client: TCP gateway hop and KCP-only gameplay transport and their PlayerLoop pump, KcpCrypto vs the sealed session, codecs, snapshot interning/merge, interpolation clock, movement prediction and reconciliation, reconnect policy, current per-packet allocation pitfalls, speed presence, subscriber isolation, headless tests.
